latest.notes:
Sortable Library columns, and a warning when an element loses its audio file.

• Click any column heading in the Library to sort by it — Title / Artist, Category, Subcategory or Length — and click again to reverse. Blanks sort last whichever way the arrow points, and titles break every tie, so a category reads alphabetically inside itself.
• The Library now warns when an element's audio file has been moved or deleted outside Avvio: a strip across the top with "Show These" to see which, and the affected rows marked. It appears without a relaunch and clears itself when the file is put back.
• Elements on an unmounted drive are not counted as missing — that's a different problem with a different fix.

Includes everything in v0.5.80: Delete and Trash in the Library (admin accounts), the assistant seeing audio file names, and cover-version separation.
